weakness: Integrator remote access always on through a cellular gateway; one shared portal login with no MFA; sessions start without company approval (14 in July 2026, 9 after hours); remote desktop service on the HMI PC with a weak password
source: P07 (AC-17 objectives); P01 R-001; P03 G-004, G-012
remediation_plan: Gateway powered off except for sessions the Operations Manager opens and watches; named portal accounts with MFA; remote desktop service disabled; portal alert on every new session; session log reviewed in the Owner's monthly meeting (POL-02 B.8)
milestones: 2026-09-01 gateway off except watched sessions; 2026-09-30 remote desktop service disabled; 2026-10-31 named portal accounts with MFA and session alerts
resources_required: Integrator project (part of about $4,500 one-time); Operations Manager time

weakness: MFA missing on the integrator portal, the accounting service (3 of 4 users), the firewall management login, and the backup console
remediation_plan: MFA on all 4 accounting users; MSP enables MFA on the firewall and backup console with named MSP accounts and sends screenshots; named portal accounts with MFA (same work as POAM-001)
milestones: 2026-09-30 accounting and MSP-held logins; 2026-10-31 integrator portal
resources_required: MSP project time (part of about $1,000 one-time); no license cost for the SaaS services

weakness: No account types, procedures, approvals, reviews, or monitoring; shared HMI operator login with engineering rights; former bookkeeper's accounting login active about 4 months
remediation_plan: Account types and the onboarding and termination checklist (POL-02 B.4); monthly reconciliation of every SaaS service, the portal, and the HMI (B.5); named HMI logins with operator and engineering roles (shared login recorded as an exception until then, POL-02 A.9)
milestones: 2026-07-16 bookkeeper login disabled; 2026-09-30 checklist in use; 2026-10-31 first monthly reconciliation; 2026-11-30 named HMI logins
resources_required: Integrator project (part of about $4,500 one-time); Office Manager time (1 hour a month)

weakness: PLC program, HMI project, and HMI PC not backed up by the company (only the integrator's 2023 copy); recipes exported monthly to one USB stick; suite backup not immutable and deletable by one MSP login without MFA
source: P07 (CP-09 objectives); P01 R-005, R-018; P03 G-020; P04 finding 3
remediation_plan: Integrator delivers the current PLC program and HMI project with checksums (configuration baseline, CM-2); weekly recipe and HMI export to an offline drive kept off site and to the cloud backup; backup upgraded to 90 days of immutable versions with MFA on the console
milestones: 2026-09-30 weekly recipe export started; 2026-10-31 immutable versions and console MFA; 2026-11-30 current program and HMI project with checksums delivered
resources_required: About $600 a year (backup); integrator project (part of about $4,500 one-time)

weakness: No restore test or contingency plan test has ever been performed
remediation_plan: Written contingency plan with the hurricane checklist; first MSP restore test of the shared drive; restore of the PLC program and HMI project onto the spare panel PC and a bench PLC; quarterly restore tests recorded; yearly tabletop with the P08 runbook
milestones: 2026-09-30 first shared-drive restore test; 2026-11-30 contingency plan and hurricane checklist; 2026-12-15 HMI and PLC restore test on spare hardware
resources_required: Spare panel PC (about $1,800 one-time); MSP and integrator time

weakness: Flat network: the HMI PC is reachable from every office device and, in testing, from a laptop on the guest Wi-Fi; the cellular gateway bypasses the managed firewall; boundary traffic is not reviewed
remediation_plan: MSP separates the guest Wi-Fi from all company devices; HMI PC moved to its own firewall segment that allows only printing to the office; gateway handled under POAM-001; network diagram kept with the SSP
milestones: 2026-09-15 guest Wi-Fi separated; 2026-10-31 network diagram; 2026-12-31 HMI segment in place and tested

weakness: HMI PC operating system out of mainstream support and unpatched since 2023; no one tracks advisories for the HMI software, PLC, or gateway; no time limits for updates
source: P07 (SI-02 objectives); P01 R-002; P03 G-017
remediation_plan: 14-day limit for critical updates on office computers in the MSP contract; integrator reviews advisories for the PLC, HMI software, and gateway each quarter and reports to the Operations Manager; application allowlisting on the HMI PC as the compensating control; supported HMI PC bought with security requirements and installed at the 2027 year-end shutdown
milestones: 2026-10-31 MSP contract term; 2026-12-31 first quarterly advisory report and allowlisting; 2027-12-31 supported HMI PC
resources_required: Integrator project (part of about $4,500 one-time); HMI PC replacement in the 2027 budget

weakness: No malicious code protection on the HMI PC; USB sticks enter it unscanned; antivirus alerts reach the MSP only in business hours and the company is never told
remediation_plan: One company USB stick scanned on an MSP-managed laptop before every use (POL-02 B.10); application allowlisting on the HMI PC with other USB storage blocked; MSP sends after-hours alerts to the Office Manager by text
milestones: 2026-09-30 single scanned USB stick in use; 2026-10-31 after-hours alert routing; 2026-12-31 allowlisting on the HMI PC
resources_required: Integrator project (part of about $4,500 one-time); MSP time

weakness: Recipe, setpoint, and alarm limit changes are not reviewed, approved, logged, or monitored; HMI audit trail off; 2 of 10 sampled batch tickets did not match the HMI recipe
source: P07 test (CM-03 objectives); P01 R-006; P03 G-007
remediation_plan: Owner's written approval on the batch ticket for every recipe and alarm limit change (POL-02 A.11); integrator change notes approved before and checked after the work; named HMI logins and the HMI audit trail enabled; change log reviewed at the Owner's monthly meeting
milestones: 2026-09-01 Owner approval rule in effect; 2026-09-30 the 2 mismatched recipes reconciled; 2026-11-30 audit trail and named logins
resources_required: Integrator project (part of about $4,500 one-time); Owner time

weakness: No security or privacy awareness training beyond the 3-yearly DOT security awareness module; new operator missed the DOT 90-day deadline; no phishing simulations
remediation_plan: Yearly cyber awareness training for all 7 employees; quarterly phishing simulations; new-hire security and DOT training on the onboarding checklist with a 60-day target; short briefing when systems change (for example the AI feature)
milestones: 2026-08-14 new operator's DOT security awareness training done; 2026-10-31 first yearly training; 2026-11-30 first phishing simulation

weakness: No time limit for removing access; shared HMI password and door code not changed after the operator left on 2026-03-13; no exit reminder
source: P07 (PS-04 objectives); P01 R-004, R-015; P03 G-008
remediation_plan: Last-day termination checklist covering SaaS accounts, HMI and portal logins, door code, keys, and a signed confidentiality reminder; change the door code and HMI password now and at every departure (POL-02 B.9)
milestones: 2026-09-15 door code and HMI password changed; 2026-09-30 checklist in use

weakness: No rule for when and how staff report cyber events; 3 of 5 staff would restart the HMI first; release reporting call list only in the office phone system; no cyber incident recipients defined
remediation_plan: Printed call list with RQs in gallons at the blend room exit, the loading dock, and in the Operations Manager's truck; reporting rule card (POL-03 4.2) at every workstation and the HMI; insurer, CISA, and FBI contacts in the P08 runbook; cyber case in the next emergency drill and tabletop
milestones: 2026-09-30 call list and reporting cards posted; 2026-11-30 tabletop with the MSP and integrator

weakness: Integrator and MSP contracts have no security terms or incident notice; the integrator switched on the AI feature without telling the company; payroll breach terms not checked; no provider monitoring
remediation_plan: Security terms in the integrator agreement and the MSP contract (POL-02 A.5: named accounts with MFA, approval before access, 24-hour incident notice, backup delivery, response commitment); payroll vendor breach terms confirmed; ERI provider confirms each SDS update; yearly vendor review including SOC 2 reports
milestones: 2026-10-31 payroll terms confirmed; 2026-11-30 ERI confirmation process; 2026-12-31 integrator and MSP terms signed
resources_required: Owner and Office Manager time; possible fee change at renewal
